_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY. The real config is generated by scripts/06-Setup-Dashboard.ps1
Administrators. Do not copy this file into place and fill it in by hand - the
salt/hash pairs must be produced by scrypt with the same parameters server.js
verifies against, which the setup script guarantees and hand-editing does not.
The only fields you should normally edit by hand after generation are 'lock'
sessionSecret: <32 random bytes, hex - regenerating this invalidates all sessions>
_lock_comment: Discover these with scripts/Get-ZWaveTopics.ps1 - Z-Wave JS UI's topic layout
depends on your node names and whether you chose named or ValueID topics, so
Door Lock CC uses 255 for secured and 0 for unsecured, but Z-Wave JS UI can be
configured to publish booleans or label strings instead. Set the payloads to
match what the state topic actually prints when you turn the deadbolt by hand.
Leave commandTopic empty to make the lock display-only. With lockPin absent,
lock control is disabled entirely regardless of what is set here.
_cameras_comment: go2rtc stream embeds. The name is the stream key from go2rtc.yaml.
The CSP in server.js permits frames from http://127.0.0.1:1984 only; if you
move go2rtc elsewhere you must widen frame-src to match.
